filing_note: Most recent 10-K available on disk; index ends Feb 2021. Filing is ~4 years stale vs cutoff 2024-09-01. Claims forward-looking from cutoff perspective are constrained to whatever this filing exposes; standing claims about program-of-record / program-element exposure remain testable via J-Book FY2026 corpus.

claims.claim_text: AVAV derived ~32% of FY2020 revenue from the U.S. Army (orders placed under contract by the U.S. Army on behalf of itself as well as several other DoD organizations) — including Switchblade and Raven small-UAS deliveries.
claims.subject: AeroVironment
claims.source_quote: During our fiscal year ended April 30, 2020, we generated approximately 32% of our revenue from the U.S. Army pursuant to orders placed under contract by the U.S. Army on behalf of itself as well as for several other organizations within the DoD.

claims.claim_text: AVAV manufactures Switchblade tactical loitering missile systems sold to organizations within the U.S. government (Army, SOCOM); Switchblade is a registered trademark and a core named product line for forward growth.
claims.subject: AeroVironment
claims.object_value: Switchblade tactical missile system as named revenue driver
claims.source_quote: We have many U.S. registered trademarks including those for AeroVironment, AV, Switchblade, Raven, Wasp, Quantix, and VAPOR ... We sell our tactical missile systems to organizations within the U.S. government.

claims.claim_text: AVAV's Raven, Puma, Wasp small UAS family is sold to the U.S. Army, USMC, SOCOM, USAF and USN as enduring procurement-of-record platforms. Small UAS contracts (incl. Army's Short Range Reconnaissance / Soldier-Borne UAS lineages) form a material part of revenue.
claims.subject: AeroVironment
claims.object_value: Raven / Puma / Wasp small UAS — multi-service U.S. military adoption
claims.source_quote: We sell the majority of our UAS and services to organizations within the DoD, including the U.S. Army, Marine Corps, Special Operations Command, Air Force and Navy, and to allied governments.

claims.claim_text: AVAV's Blackwing — the first submarine-launched unmanned aircraft system deployed by the U.S. Navy — is a named program line claimed in forward narrative.
claims.subject: AeroVironment
claims.object_value: Blackwing submarine-launched UAS — U.S. Navy program
claims.source_quote: Blackwing, the first submarine-launched unmanned aircraft system deployed by the U.S. Navy.

claims.claim_text: AVAV asserts that other U.S. government agencies and government subcontractors accounted for 22% of FY2020 sales revenue. Sales to U.S. government, either as prime or sub (incl. FMS), represented ~61% of FY2020 revenue; DoD specifically ~51% of FY2020 revenue.
claims.subject: AeroVironment
claims.object_value: 61% USG revenue (51% DoD direct + ~10% other USG/subs) FY2020
claims.source_quote: Sales to the U.S. government, either as a prime contractor or subcontractor and inclusive of foreign military sales, represented approximately 61% of our revenue for the fiscal year ended April 30, 2020. The DoD, our principal U.S. government customer, accounted for approximately 51% of our revenue for the fiscal year ended April 30, 2020.

claims.claim_text: Award contract with U.S. Army Contracting Command Redstone Arsenal (Missile), dated August 30, 2012, and multiple contract modifications (P00015 in 2013, P00074 in 2016) — this is the underlying contractual base for tactical missile (Switchblade) deliveries, named as a material exhibit.
claims.subject: AeroVironment
claims.object_value: U.S. Army Contracting Command Redstone Arsenal Missile base contract (Aug 2012) + mods
claims.source_quote: 10.29 (13) Contract modification P00015 dated September 5, 2013 under the base contract with the US Army Contracting Command Redstone Arsenal (Missile) dated August 30, 2012; 10.30 (14) Contract modification P00074 dated September 27, 2016 under the base contract with the US Army Contracting Command Redstone Arsenal (Missile) dated August 30, 2012.

claims.claim_text: AVAV depends on continued congressional appropriations and Pentagon funding for its programs of record; risk-factor narrative explicitly flags exposure to Balanced Budget Act constraints and spending cutbacks.
claims.subject: AeroVironment
claims.object_value: forward narrative tied to DoD appropriations / programs of record
claims.source_quote: The funding of U.S. government programs is uncertain and dependent on continued congressional appropriations and administrative allotment of funds based on an annual budgeting process ... The U.S. military funds our contracts primarily through operational needs statements, and to a lesser extent, through programs of record, which provides us with less visibility and certainty on future funding allocations for our contracts.

claims.claim_text: HAPSMobile Inc. — the SoftBank JV in which AVAV owns ~7% — accounted for 17% of total revenue in FY2020 via the Design and Development Agreement (DDA) up to $166.1M, plus AVAV expects continued HAPSMobile revenue through Sunglider development. (Non-DoD / non-J-Book commercial JV control claim.)
claims.subject: AeroVironment
claims.object_value: HAPSMobile (SoftBank JV) — 17% of FY2020 revenue; $166M DDA
claims.source_quote: Under the DDA and related efforts, the Company will use its best efforts, up to a maximum value of $166,108,000 ... The Company recorded revenue under the DDA and preliminary design agreements between the Company and SoftBank of $60,864,000, $55,407,000 and $29,594,000 for the fiscal years ended April 30, 2020, 2019 and 2018, respectively.

claims.claim_text: AVAV had 202 issued/retained U.S. patents and 104 pending U.S. patent applications as of April 30, 2020 — patent-portfolio claim used to justify innovation-leadership thesis. (Non-J-Book control claim.)
claims.subject: AeroVironment
claims.object_value: 202 issued U.S. patents + 104 pending applications as of 4/30/2020
claims.source_quote: As of April 30, 2020, we had issued and retained 202 U.S. patents, as well as 104 pending U.S. patent applications; 26 active Patent Cooperation Treaty applications; and numerous foreign patents and pending applications.
